params.message:
Docs that describe the code as it is; the reset phase goes

CLAUDE.md listed sixteen adapters (bilibili, douyin and patents gone, twitter off,
china-hotrank and the academic ones missing) and described account-balance.mjs, which
no longer exists. It now points at the adapter register and describes accountsToTry.
Usage lines in eight scripts still said node workflow/<x>.mjs; they give the real path.
docs/server-setup.sh and server-remaining.sh set up a box with crontab lines for
workflow/*.mjs, which has not been how the server runs for months. The LaTeX .aux and
.out files next to the architecture paper are build output and are ignored now.

The Reset phase (POST /run/reset) ran workflow/reset.mjs, which deletes every signal,
hashtag, correction and scout log row. It could not run, because it imported a path
that does not exist; the danger was that someone would fix the import. Nothing calls
it, so the phase, the script and resetDB are removed.
